name: FUN_DOCIO_STEP_EXECUTIONS
description: This table contains individual step execution details of a given flow.It provides real-time monitoring that captures essential metrics and statuses for each flow step instances.

columns.name: FLOW_STEP_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Document IO flow step execution. This is an unique id for the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: FLOW_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the flow execution for the input and output of the document flow step instance.

columns.name: STEP_CODE
columns.description: Flow step code for the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Identifies status code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_STEP_STATUSES.

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: Retry count for the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: NEXT_RETRY_TIME
columns.description: Indicates start date and time of the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Indicates start date and time of the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Indicates end date and time of the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: STEP_SUMMARY_JSON
columns.description: Step summary for the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: STEP_PROCESS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies step process type for the Document IO flow step instance.Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_FLOW_STEP_TYPES.

columns.name: STEP_PROCESS_ID_LIST
columns.description: Step process IDs for the Document IO flow step instance.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies document type code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_DOC_TYPES.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the document associated with the execution step.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
